svg.text: B2B Account Signal Monitor — Components Map
Which of Arjun's 10 accounts are warm this week, and why. Live news → Gemini Flash → Supabase → Hot List email + dashboard. Deployed on Vercel.
LIVE external data, no key needed
fetch + parse RSS, de-dupe headlines, max 15/account
skip URLs in signals / seen_articles → each
article goes to Gemini at most once
• about this company? • is it a trigger?
• type: headcount · new CHRO/VP Ops · funding
+ stage-aware outreach angle tied to the product
same event, many outlets → counted once
if the engine writes, manual columns are
audit log: articles, triggers, errors, email sent
summary: hot list size, next send
right accounts at the right time
